question: T12 (task-e0483f7527887d8c, task-7d124291d6b2138d, task-b203492d0439a57d, task-968ce83b5e23f2f4): how a Wave Intensity drag ends, and CAP-T12BELOW g read again. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10, phone 1/2/3/10 and 3/2/5/10). Mobile View (the frame 428 wide, then back to Desktop View) for g, E and F; K stays on the desktop. Select the Scrolling block, Edit, Design, the presses on Wave Intensity (179 is the press at the range's end, read as 180), then a real drag through one DevTools session: a press on the range at its first value, a move to each next value gap ms apart. g: 180>150>120 pressed, as CAP-T12BELOW g. E: 90 pressed, a drag 90>120>150>180>150>120>90 at 300 ms; 300 ms after the last move a real Escape while the pointer is still held, a read, then the let go on 90 and a read. F: 90 pressed, a drag 90>120>150>180>150>120 at 1500 ms, let go on 120 1500 ms after the last move. K: 90 pressed, a drag 90>120>150>180>150>120>90 at 300 ms let go on 90, then one real ArrowRight with no press first (keys: the focus and value before and after). Then Escape (let go, 'go') and Cmd+Z, a read after each; E, F and K's Cmd+Z ('Z') only while the section is not back as built. R1 ran gEFK, R2 KFE, two edit sessions. Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: As CAP-T12BELOW: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's input, change and pointer events by the page's clock, and E's states (value, focus, selected blocks, lines, Undo/Redo) held, after the Escape and after the let go; 'keys' holds K's states. The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('z' and 'Z' are Cmd+Z).
answer: g, read a third time, as CAP-T12BELOW R1 and R2: in the phone view 180, 150 and 120 leave 1/2/8/10, 1/2/6/10 and 1/2/6/10; after the let go the first Cmd+Z gives back 150 at 1/2/7/10 (block 199, the Text block 7/2/9/10, 8 rows), the next 180 at 1/2/8/10, the next the section as built.

E: Escape pressed while a phone drag 90 out to 180 and back to 90 is held takes the selection off and closes the panel, and ends the drag as its let go does: the rows held (1/2/4/10, the Text block 4/2/6/10, 5 rows, the line 120 high) stay after the Escape and after the pointer is let go, Undo on. One Cmd+Z gives back 1/2/5/10 as after the press, the next the section as built. The pointerup after the Escape lands on no range (no change event).

F: a slow phone drag 90>120>150>180>150>120 at 1500 ms let go on 120 (a change event fires) leaves 1/2/6/10 (the Text block 6/2/8/10, 7 rows, block 164, the line 150 high). Cmd+Z goes back one value a step: 150 at 1/2/7/10, 180 at 1/2/8/10, 150 at 1/2/7/10, 120 at 1/2/6/10, 90 at 1/2/5/10, then the section as built.

K: on the desktop, after a drag 90 out to 180 and back to 90 let go on 90 (no change event; 1/2/5/26, the Text block 5/2/7/10, 12 rows), the range keeps the focus: one ArrowRight with no press first steps Wave Intensity to 120 and the block stays at 1/2/5/26 (the line 154 high in a block 154). Cmd+Z takes back the key's step (the line 124), then the drag's (the Text block back at 3/2/5/10, 10 rows), then the press.

R1 and R2 read alike in all 33 reads they share but R2's first (K open), whose Redo was left on by the plan read before it. Not read: Escape during a desktop drag or a drag let go elsewhere, a touch drag, the same key after a phone drag, Redo.
